Search summary: 23 courses (6 beginner, 8 intermediate, 9 advanced), 34.4 km of pistes, '10 lifts and a 3,300 m gondola' — unclear whether the gondola is included in the 10, so the total is left unknown. Courses sit on Mt. Asari and Mt. Nagamine
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Resort hotels sit at the base; details not on file

character: A resort in the mountains between Sapporo and Niseko, spread over Mt. Asari and Mt. Nagamine, known for very high snowfall. Accommodation is clustered at a single resort base rather than a traditional village.
learning: 6 of the 23 courses are rated beginner (search summary). Reference, confirm: ski school and rentals operate at the base.
